entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: An ancient golden artifact from the Onakke catacombs on Shandalar that turns its wearer into a vessel for the Onakke and masks the wearer's soul.

entities.name: Onakke
entities.description: An ancient people of Shandalar whose spirits dwell in the Veil.

entities.name: Shandalar
entities.description: Plane where the Onakke catacombs hide the Veil.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker who wields the Chain Veil and is haunted by its spirits.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A planeswalker turned into a demon by the Veil.

entities.name: Raven Man
entities.description: A mysterious individual interested in the Veil, which preserved part of Lim-Dûl's essence.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl
entities.description: Someone whose essence part was preserved in the Veil.

entities.name: Kothophed
entities.description: A demon who instructed Liliana to retrieve the Veil and was destroyed by her.

entities.name: Griselbrand
entities.description: A demon destroyed by Liliana using the Veil.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: A planeswalker to whom Liliana passed the demon curse.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: An Eldrazi Titan temporarily harmed by Liliana with the Veil on Innistrad.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: Plane where Liliana tried to exorcise the Veil.

entities.name: Dierk
entities.description: A geistmage who helped Liliana try to exorcise the Veil.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: Loaned a witchbane orb to Liliana.

entities.name: Josu Vess
entities.description: Liliana's brother, kept undead by a lich spell.

entities.name: Belzenlok
entities.description: Demon who was Liliana's creditor.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Liliana's ancestral home plane.

entities.name: Zahid
entities.description: A powerful djinn subdued by Liliana with the Veil.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: Appeared to Liliana through the Spirit-Gem.

entities.name: Teyo Verada
entities.description: Used shield magic to transport the Veil to Ravnica.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Dragon who was to keep the Veil in a puzzle box.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Plane where the Veil was stored in a vault.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: Artifact that breached Ravnica during the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The battle on Ravnica in which Liliana used the Veil intensively.

events.summary: Liliana retrieves the Chain Veil from the Shandalar catacombs as instructed by Kothophed, then uses it to destroy Kothophed and Griselbrand and pass the demon curse to Garruk.
events.quote: retrieved the Chain Veil from the catacombs at Shandalar

events.summary: On Innistrad Liliana fails to exorcise the Veil's spirits, but harms Emrakul with the Veil's power.
Liliana uses the Veil on Dominaria to break the lich spell on her brother Josu.
events.quote: Liliana used the Veil again on Dominaria

events.summary: During the War of the Spark, the Onakke spirits emerge to protect Liliana and she drains Eternals to heal.
events.quote: the Onakke spirits emerged from the Veil itself to protect her

events.summary: Liliana subdues Zahid with the Veil, then gives up the Veil as the Spirit-Gem fades; Teyo sends it to Ravnica as proof of her death.
events.quote: Liliana dropped the Veil and gave it up

events.summary: Realmbreaker's breach lets the Veil's magic empower the dormant Onakke.
events.quote: allowing the foul magic of the Veil to seep out

relations.note: Destroyed him while wearing the Veil.
Instructed her to retrieve the Veil.
relations.quote: as instructed by the demon Kothophed
hidden within the ancient catacombs of the Onakke at Shandalar
